summary: Iteration 8 — Worker Deploy page (admin-only) end-to-end testing. Backend: 14/14 tests passing (probe + smoke + admin-gating + 8 regression endpoints). Frontend: Playwright verified the full /worker UI — sidebar 'Worker Deploy' nav link visible for admin, page renders with status card ('Worker reachable but returned 403', url=https://ecostamp.net, status=403, OFFLINE pill, last_check timestamp), Re-probe button works and refreshes last_check, Smoke panel populates 5 rows (/health, /status, /spreads, /opportunities, /balances) all showing HTTP 403 + SHAPE MISMATCH + err 'http 403', overall pill renders as 'ISSUES' (red/danger), 6 runbook steps present with copy buttons, 4 troubleshooting cards rendered. Regression nav verified: Dashboard, Autopilot, A/B Test, Users, Alerts, Audit all reachable. Behavior matches the EXPECTED 403 state (ecostamp.net is intentionally unreachable).

critical_code_review_comments: WorkerDeploy.jsx is 415 lines — still manageable but approaching the 700-line cap. If more panels are added, split SmokePanel + Runbook + Troubleshooting + CustomURL into separate files under /pages/worker-deploy/.
server.py is now 1704 lines — STRONGLY recommend modularization (routers/auth.py, routers/bot.py, routers/autopilot.py, routers/worker.py, routers/safety.py). Same recommendation as iter7.

/api/worker/smoke fires 5 sequential httpx requests with each ~10s timeout potential — could take 50s when fully unreachable. Consider asyncio.gather() for parallel probes to reduce worst-case latency from N*timeout to max(timeout). Currently fine because ecostamp.net returns 403 within ms.

SmokeRow testid uses row.path.replace('/', '') which only strips the FIRST '/' — works today but fragile if a nested path is added (e.g. '/market/health' → 'markethealth'). Use .replaceAll('/', '-') or slice(1).
_SMOKE_ENDPOINTS list is hard-coded in server.py; consider deriving from worker_client's actual endpoint registry so adding a new endpoint there auto-extends smoke coverage.
